title: Conditional entropy realization and approximation by uniquely ergodic measures
summary: This paper studies conditional entropy realization and weak* approximation by uniquely ergodic measures with compact support. We prove that, after fixing an admissible potential average and an entropy strictly below the entropy supremum over the corresponding average fiber, every invariant measure satisfying these two exact constraints can be approximated weakly* by uniquely ergodic measures with compact support satisfying the same constraints. Each approximating measure is the unique invariant measure on its minimal support, whose topological entropy equals the prescribed metric entropy.…
